adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the save action. When saving, `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` is sent to the server. If categoryId is null/blank, the server sets it to uncategorized_category_id (line 24 in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb). However, the client-side code then does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` which looks up the category using the original null categoryId, not the server's response. This would result in setting category to null/undefined on the client even though the server saved uncategorized. The UI would show blank until reload.
